provenance.note: Decoration only, conformed to the park_pit bake; rebuild after a re-bake. Procedural, authored in this repository from Blender bmesh sheets; no external mesh. No -col mesh: the stamped terrain stays the only collider. Ships a flush sandstone sheet: banded strata relief of at most 0.06 m with colour bands and varnish streaks inside the lane. Flush lane: every vertex inside any ride row's footprint stays within 0.12 m of the ground, the verge band included, and the sheet ships no rim props (no rocks, no tufts) and no detail shells.
